_readme: Static plate folders (shipped files). One list per character per beat. Drop the file in assets/plates/<character>/<beat>/ and add its URL here. In production the admin page replaces this with the server manifest at /keyhole/plates (media_assets tagged with a beat). A beat with an empty list is OFF; the engine will not invent it live. Entries may be a URL string or {"url", "variant", "durationSec"}.
